intent: Give a researcher an explicit industry-level view of open/conflict states without collapsing different epistemic meanings. The default historical lane must show only archive-reconstructed Reality source disagreements and typed Judgment contradictions/counterarguments visible from source-known records by the requested cutoff. An optional current research-only overlay may show unresolved Memory disagreements/hypotheses and explicitly recorded model-memory coverage gaps, but must be labelled as present research state rather than historical market knowledge. Missing rows or search not-found must never be converted into a negative fact or synthetic unknown.
rationale: The required truth primitives already exist, but the read/composition boundary is incomplete. CAP-0003 owns explicit Fact reconciliation/conflict semantics and needs a typed source-disagreement read boundary; CAP-0004 Judgment contradicts/counterargument records are already available through the CAP-0005 typed replay snapshot and can be reused unchanged; CAP-0006 owns research-only Memory disagreement, hypothesis and campaign coverage states and needs a typed read boundary; CAP-0005 is the existing researcher projection/navigation owner and should compose these lanes without changing their authority. A dual-lane contract is required because current research-only state is not historical market knowledge and must never leak into the default point-in-time replay experience.
